nodes.label: Qwen3.8 Max LiteLLM proxy route (qwen-jury)
nodes.rationale: Routes Claude Code's Anthropic-format requests to a free-tier Qwen model via TokenRouter's OpenAI-compatible API so it can be used as an LLM jury/judge. drop_params is enabled because Claude Code sends a reasoning_effort value ('high') that does not match TokenRouter's accepted values for this model, and drop_params strips unrecognized parameters instead of erroring. num_retries/request_timeout are set higher than a paid endpoint would need because the free tier is documented as unstable.
